messages:
Asha: Heads up — RatePilot price-sheet pilot goes live tomorrow morning. Need quick alignment on invoice reconciliation and grandfathering rules for the pilot cohort. Sheet: https://go.redwood/ratepilot-sheet (view-only for now). Can finance + eng + legal confirm plan?

Ben: Which customers are in the pilot cohort exactly? Sales told me it's a mix of paid pilot customers + 5 legacy enterprise accounts.

Marta: From RevOps side: cohort = pilot_paid (n=12), pilot_free_trial (n=8), legacy_enterprise (n=5). Proposal: auto-grandfather pilot_paid for 2 billing cycles, pilot_free_trial get one cycle, legacy_enterprise handled case-by-case.

Kai: @Asha @Marta I need to validate metering mapping. Staging showed a small token delta after the streaming flush fix:
```
report: token_count_delta = +0.5% (stream_flush)
affected_customers: pilot_paid cohort sample
```
I'll run a token_counter pass tonight and post results.

billing-bot: reconcile-run 2087 triggered by Asha
status: partial-fail
failed_rows: acct_001, acct_045, acct_078
error: CSV schema mismatch on column 'grandfather_flag'

Asha: Ok noted. @Kai can you include a mapping script to normalize grandfather_flag values (true/false/legacy) before reconcile? Also @Oliver we need legal sign-off on grandfather durations and messaging.

Oliver: Legal ok with 2 cycles for paying pilots, but require opt-out language and retention of previous pricing in audit logs. I'll send a short approval email. :white_check_mark:

Marta: I'll draft the opt-out email and a billing FAQ. Updated the sheet column 'final_price' and added a 'grandfather_until' date for each account.

Ben: Heads-up to sales: please freeze any manual price edits for pilot accounts until we lock the sheet. Pinged #sales-channel.

Asha: Timeline: lock price-sheet EOD today, run reconcile script tomorrow 06:00 UTC, send opt-out batch Tue 10:00 local. @Kai please run the reconcile smoke test after normalization. If reconcile passes, we'll proceed with invoice patching (dry-run first).

Kai: Will run smoke test and post logs. If I hit any blockers I'll DM.

Marta: I'll prepare the dry-run invoice CSV and attach it to the sheet. Also setting a watch on refunds/credit flag.

billing-bot: dry-run complete — no schema errors on normalized feed. 0 refunds flagged. :eyes: 

Ben: Thanks team. After dry-run, notify sales + CS so they can prep customer comms.

Asha: Great. One more ask: capture a short postmortem if we need to rollback grandfathering or adjust cohort rules. Let's stay conservative for week 1. :memo:

Oliver: Noted. I'll include legal escalation contacts in the email.

(ends)
